blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines completed an elimination-round sweep of Ateneo with an 82-74 win on Sunday in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum. With the repeat over the Blue Eagles, the Fighting Maroons hiked their winning streak to seven and clinched a spot in the Final Four with three games left in the eliminations.
